top_signals.title: Tankers continue to burn in the Middle East despite hopes for de-escalation
top_signals.summary: There is little sign of attacks abating in November, after 37 ships were attacked in October, the highest monthly total since the start of the war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: More suicides at U.S. spy, cyber agencies scrutinized by Congress
top_signals.summary: At least 11 National Security Agency and U.S. Cyber Command workers died by suicide over roughly the past year, officials and public records say.

top_signals.title: Hackers exploit trusted AWS access to breach multiple cloud environments
top_signals.summary: A threat actor used compromised identity and access management (IAM) credentials for a Qubole big data platform's AWS account to access and exfiltrate data from multiple customers' AWS environments. [...]
